'''Beraxil ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]] she was on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] when former Sith Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] came to the world and possessed many of the Imperials on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], turning them into his puppets to murder civilians. Beraxil was among those who fell under his control and she was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the fighting.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Beraxil was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' in game update 3.2.
